from.place: perfect-generation proof: affine base case, where O_X is a perfect generator

title: Affine quasi-coherent derived categories have a perfect generator
statement: If X = Spec(A) is affine [def-pc-scheme], then O_X is a perfect object [def-pc-perfect-complex] of D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] and, for every E in D_QCoh(O_X), E is zero if and only if Hom(O_X[n], E) is zero for every integer n [def-pc-generators].
